projects.name: ODOT TransGIS - STIP 2027-2030 Lines - Current
projects.notes: ODOT 2027-2030 STIP projects mapped as lines, refreshed daily (GIS_PRC_DT was 11/16/2026). No work-type field: the type of work is only in PROJ_DESC free text. MNTR_CD is the monitor code: PSEDOC = still in design (plans/specs/estimate), CONST = construction phase. BID_LET_DT (epoch ms) is the bid letting date; future date = not yet let. STIP_FIRST_YR_NO / PROJ_PHASE_CURRENT_STIP_YR_NO give the STIP year. ADMINISTRATOR_ID tells ODOT vs LOCAL delivery. Layer ids in this large catalog service are not guaranteed stable; re-find by layer name if 417 changes.

parcels_counties.name: Multnomah County Taxlot Parcels (Multnomah County Tax Parcels)
parcels_counties.notes: ArcGIS Online hosted layer (item owner harperb_AGO, item modified Dec 2025) described as tax lots from the Multnomah County Division of Assessment, Recording and Taxation; ROLLYEAR 2025 in the sample. PROPID (e.g. R186993) is the county account id; ROLLM50 is the Measure 50 assessed value; DEED_DATE, SALE_PRICE, PROPCLASS, ZONING also present. ADDR1 can be a care-of line ('%LINCOLN PROPERTY CO') with the street in ADDR2. Spatial point+distance query works as-is: 51 parcels at -122.6765,45.5152 (.../query?geometry=-122.6765,45.5152&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&distance=200&units=esriSRUnit_Meter&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&f=json). Terms read: the item's terms of use say only 'This map data is for reference use only ... Multnomah County GIS disclaims all responsibility for the accuracy or completeness' (https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=13a535596a1f4fe0887b03d14d943229); no limit on commercial use or solicitation is stated there. The county's own servers (www3.multco.us, portlandmaps.com) timed out.

parcels_counties.name: Jackson County GIS - OpenData/ReferenceData - Tax Lots
parcels_counties.notes: County's own server (Medford/Ashland), maxRecordCount 1000, native spatial reference wkid 2270. ACCOUNT is the assessor account; INCAREOF and CONTRACT (contract purchaser) also present; ASSESSLAND / ASSESSIMP are assessed values. Spatial point+distance query works as-is: 112 parcels at -122.8756,42.3265. No terms-of-use page could be opened (jacksoncountyor.gov GIS page returned 403); the layer's copyright text only says 'Please extend credit to Jackson County GIS in any subsequent works derived from its data', and the county's ArcGIS Online items carry a warranty disclaimer with no use limits. A City of Medford layer (maps.medfordmaps.org/.../Public/Taxlots_with_SiteAddresses_Service/MapServer/1, 34,444 records, same field names) covers the Medford area only.

parcels_counties.name: Deschutes County - Dial2_Taxlots - Taxlot (joined to assessor account and mailing table)
parcels_counties.notes: County's own server (Bend/Redmond), the layer behind the county DIAL property viewer. Field names carry the joined-table prefix exactly as shown (use them in outFields and where clauses, e.g. where=dbo_GIS_MAILING.OWNER IS NOT NULL). dbo_GIS_MAILING.ACCOUNT_ID, AGENT, IN_CARE_OF and M_CITYSTZIP also present; a taxlot with several accounts appears once per account (112,485 rows for 109,596 taxlots). No value or acreage fields. maxRecordCount 1000. Spatial point+distance query works as-is: 204 records at -121.3153,44.0582. Operational_Layers/MapServer/0 on the same server has owner name only. The county's ArcGIS Online taxlot layers (services1.arcgis.com/znO8Hz1SuVVohYhZ/.../Taxlots, Taxlot_Assessor_Account_view, Taxlots_and_Account_Mailing_view_layer) have NO owner fields. Terms read: the county's ArcGIS Online taxlot items state 'Free to download and use' / 'Full source data is available on our data portal site and is free to download and use' (item 901cdd4a5ca24cc3b72cc8e3e0f11f02); no terms are attached to this map service itself and deschutes.org disclaimer pages timed out.

parcels_counties.name: Benton_Polk_Taxlots_Combined (copy hosted by the Luckiamute Watershed Council; Polk County rows)
parcels_counties.restrictions: terms not found: the item's licenseInfo, credit and description are empty; third-party copy, not published by Polk County, and no Polk County terms were read
parcels_counties.notes: NOT the county's own service: a watershed council's ArcGIS Online copy (item b304da3f0eda40daa6b9553bfc1c2a0b 'LWC Taxlots_WFL1', owner LuckiamuteMonitoring, public), summary: 'Updated version of the LWC service area tax lots (Sep 2026) ... compiled by downloading and merging vector taxlot geometry and assessor property records directly from the official GIS REST service endpoints of Benton County and Polk County'. The layer holds 143,253 rows for both counties and has no county field: the first 107,938 rows (FID 1-107938) match Benton County's TaxlotOwners layer row for row, and the remaining 35,315 (where=FID>107938, all with Party_Name) are taken to be Polk County (samples are Dallas, OR addresses with Polk-style map numbers such as '7.5.34A'); record_count is that Polk subset. Check this split before relying on it. A snapshot from September 2026, not live. No value or acreage fields. Layer 2 of the same service (PolkCountyTaxlots_Merge) has the wider Polk assessor columns (AcctTable_OwnerLine1, AcctTable_MailAdd1 ...), not inspected. Polk County's own REST endpoint was not found (maps.co.polk.or.us and gis.co.polk.or.us did not answer). Spatial reference Web Mercator; maxRecordCount 2000.

summary: ODOT STIP 2027-2030 and 2024-2027 line/point layers verified with cost, bid-let date and design/construction code (no structured work-type field). Parcels: no statewide owner layer; Lane County and a city-hosted copy of Marion County verified. Multnomah/Washington/Clackamas (Metro RLIS) have no owner names in public layers; portlandmaps.com timed out. Second pass 2026-11-17: Multnomah, Jackson and Deschutes county layers with owner name and mailing address verified, each answering point+distance spatial queries; Washington and Clackamas publish no owner names. Third pass 2026-11-26: added Josephine, Klamath, Yamhill, Benton and Umatilla county layers with owner name and mailing address, plus third-party copies for Coos (ODF, stale, about 2019-2021), Linn (student demonstration copy, owner name only) and Polk (watershed council snapshot, Sep 2026); only Yamhill has restrictions null, the rest are held (terms not found or a limiting statement). The OWRD statewide 'Tax Lots' query layer (13 counties) has owner mailing address but no owner name; no county-published owner layer found for Douglas (bot challenge), Columbia or Lincoln.
